releaseNotes:
Partely first customer release
Android 1.5.1 (version code 16) · Windows 1.1.1

This release includes the customer, sales, inventory, subscription, navigation, and help improvements prepared for the first customer installation.

- Credit sales now require a saved customer on both platforms. Historical sale identities remain visible and can be saved from the customer selector before use.
- Sales steps block invalid navigation and show field-level errors. Credit due dates are required consistently, including partial payments.
- Dashboard and reports count part records consistently; inventory rows continue to show each part's unit quantity.
- Supplier Orders has its own Windows sidebar destination and full screen.
- Subscription entitlements refresh when the screen opens, after renewal, and periodically while the app is foregrounded.
- The Partely Windows Manual is bundled and available from Help & Support on Android and Windows.
- Help Center guidance has been refreshed for the current sales and inventory workflows.
- Removed the Android online/offline popup while retaining background connectivity handling.
- The developer name shown in the app is CHIRA.
